title: Microsoft Tests Fix After Hours-Long Outlook Email Disruption
dek: Microsoft says it is testing a remedy for widespread Outlook problems that caused email delays and delivery failures.
socialCaption: Microsoft is testing a fix for widespread Outlook issues that caused email delays and failures. For businesses, the outage is a reminder to plan backup communications for workflows that still depend on the inbox.
